metadata.project: SWAL Decentralized Node Authentication & Sovereign Enclave Mesh
metadata.target_network: SWAL Mesh + Cloudflare Genesis + Polygon PoS Anchor

features.name: Cloudflare Genesis Node Ephemeral Challenge Generation
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents replay and pre-computation attacks via strictly random nonces with 60s auto-expiry
features.acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/auth/challenge returns hex-encoded 32-byte nonce with TTL=60s stored in KV

features.name: Ed25519 Sovereign Signature Verification on Cloudflare Edge
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents identity spoofing; Genesis node verifies cryptographic proof without possessing private keys
features.acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/auth/verify accepts public_key, signature, and nonce; issues swal_sess_ token on valid match

features.name: Single-Use Nonce & Ephemeral TTL Anti-Replay Guard
features.cryptographic_primitive: Time-bounded nonce lookup with immediate cache purge
features.threat_mitigation: Mitigates network eavesdropping and replay attacks. An intercepted signature is invalid after 60s or upon first verification
features.verified_by: Automated unit test testing expired nonce rejection
features.acceptance_criteria: Replayed valid signature with expired or consumed nonce returns 400 Bad Request

features.name: Client-Side Ed25519 Sovereign Node Key Pair Generation & Persistence
features.threat_mitigation: Keys generated in browser sandbox; private keys never leave local browser memory in plaintext
features.acceptance_criteria: PWA derives deterministic node_id (node_{hex(sha256(pk)[:8])}) and persists in secure storage

features.name: 1-Click Sovereign Mesh Login Flow (Zero-Password / Zero-Email)
features.threat_mitigation: Eliminates password leaks, phishing, and credential stuffing vectors entirely
features.verified_by: Playwright E2E UI verification on https://xavier.swal.network
features.acceptance_criteria: User clicks 'CONECTAR NODO Y ENTRAR (VAULT)', signs challenge transparently, enters session state with +10 Karma

features.name: Background Heartbeat Daemon for Proof of Availability (PoA)
features.cryptographic_primitive: HMAC / Session Bearer Auth via TLS 1.3
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents dead peer ghosting in mesh routing table
features.acceptance_criteria: PWA client posts /v1/mesh/heartbeat every 300s; Genesis updates last_seen timestamp

features.name: Karma Incentivization & Public Peer Directory
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents spamming heartbeat endpoints to artificially inflate karma balances
features.verified_by: Production query returning node_id with 10 Karma and live peer count
features.acceptance_criteria: +10 Karma on registration, +1 Karma per confirmed 300s heartbeat period

features.name: E2E Automated Integration Suite for Sovereign Node Auth
features.threat_mitigation: Guarantees zero regression on cryptographic handshakes during production releases
features.acceptance_criteria: Simulates cold browser boot, node key derivation, challenge sign, and successful authenticated UI render

features.name: Samsung Knox Vault / Android StrongBox Hardware KEK Sealing
features.cryptographic_primitive: AndroidKeyStore NIST P-256 (secp256r1) KEK wrapping AES-256-GCM
features.threat_mitigation: Protects Ed25519 identity against root compromises, memory scraping, and OS exploits on Android
features.verified_by: Flutter unit test + Rust OpenedVault ZeroizeOnDrop and HardwareEnclaveProvider in vault.rs
features.details_missing: Integration of BiometricPrompt to mandate fingerprint/face scan before hardware key unwrap.
features.acceptance_criteria: Device verifies KeyInfo.isInsideSecurityHardware() == true; unwrap requires BiometricPrompt authentication

features.name: Linux TPM 2.0 Hardware Storage Root Sealing
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents extraction of node keys by offline cold-boot or physical SSD extraction
features.details_missing: 1) PCR policy sealing (binding decryption to Platform Configuration Registers PCR 0-7 to guarantee untampered kernel/initramfs); 2) Automated TPM2 NVRAM provisioning script.
features.acceptance_criteria: Keys sealed to TPM 2.0 primary storage hierarchy; fails gracefully with audited warning if TPM unavailable

features.name: WebAuthn / FIDO2 PRF Extension Hardware Bridge for Web PWA
features.threat_mitigation: Enables physical smartphone biometric chip to back the Web PWA without needing an APK installed
features.acceptance_criteria: Browser prompts for TouchID / Windows Hello / Android Knox biometric prompt on login, deriving hardware-anchored seed

features.name: Shamir Secret Sharing (2-of-3) Zero-Knowledge Sharding Engine
features.cryptographic_primitive: Shamir's Secret Sharing over GF(256) with k=2, n=3 threshold
features.threat_mitigation: Eliminates Cloudflare as a single point of failure; Cloudflare holds 1 share which yields 0 bits of information regarding master key
features.verified_by: Rust unit tests in persist.rs (test_cloud_share_encryption_roundtrip) and shamir.rs (26/26 passed)
features.acceptance_criteria: Reconstruction mathematically fails with any 1 share; succeeds 100% with any 2 shares (e.g., Device + User Mnemonic)

features.name: BIP-39 Mnemonic Seed Generation & Disaster Recovery Sheet
features.cryptographic_primitive: BIP-39 12-word english wordlist over Share 2 entropy
features.threat_mitigation: Allows full recovery when physical hardware is destroyed or dropped in water without cloud custody risk
features.acceptance_criteria: User can reconstruct full node identity on a brand new browser by supplying Share 2 (12 words) + Share 3 (Cloudflare backup)

features.name: Direct Peer-to-Peer WebRTC DataChannel Mesh Synchronization
features.cryptographic_primitive: DTLS / SCTP over WebRTC with Noise Protocol handshake
features.threat_mitigation: Removes Cloudflare Genesis node from peer-to-peer data plane; prevents traffic analysis of peer messaging
features.details_missing: 1) Signaling protocol over Cloudflare Worker WebSocket / SSE to exchange SDP offers/answers; 2) P2P DHT (Kademlia or libp2p) client running inside browser Service Worker; 3) Encrypted fragment exchange between live nodes.
features.acceptance_criteria: Two active browser nodes can exchange encrypted fragments directly without payload passing through Cloudflare

features.name: Karma Ledger Merkle Root Anomaly-Resistant Polygon PoS Rollup
features.cryptographic_primitive: Sparse Merkle Tree (SMT) with Poseidon / Keccak-256 hash function
features.threat_mitigation: Prevents arbitrary karma minting or tampering by Genesis operator; guarantees verifiable on-chain audit trail
features.verified_by: Cargo test polygon_anchor (9/9 passed) + Playwright E2E + PR #2143 integration
features.acceptance_criteria: Daily Merkle root published on-chain; any peer can generate cryptographic proof of their karma balance
